Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. body:
It’s time to put the power back into the hands of our neighbors.
#
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260420.MsjlS-&amount=5&refcode=em20260420-502&t=1&akid=502%2E34582%2E6heohv)
Peter, I have some big news. **I’m launching something new today** , and I want you to be a part of it from the jump.
I grew up in the kind of small town where everybody knew everybody, everybody’s kids played together, and everybody helped when someone was in trouble.
We used to gather together as neighbors to celebrate after football games and graduations. More often than not, our gatherings took place at our local public school.
My public school was foundational. It was more than my education and the name on my jersey: it was the place our town came to meet. Heck, the school was the town.
As I’ve visited small towns in other states over the years, I’ve witnessed a similar sentiment. In red districts and blue, I’ve heard about cherished local schools and how they serve as the cornerstones of their communities.
But nowadays I’m seeing a disturbing new trend as those cornerstones are starting to crumble: **Local schools are closing after funding cuts, and they’re followed by other foundational pieces of the community.**
The local grocery store? _Gone._ The local clinic? _Gone_. The job with a decent wage? _Gone_.
Everyone and everything seems to be packing up and leaving town. We’re losing our neighbors. We’re losing our communities. And we aren't talking to each other anymore.
This is what it looks like to defund and divide America, and it’s because of Republicans like Donald Trump and JD Vance, who are willing to sell out our communities and working families for their own political and financial gain.
Why is Elon Musk closing schools in America? Why are we being told that any of the hardships our communities are facing have to do with immigration? The problem isn't your neighbor. It’s the tech bros and billionaires who pay to take turns cosplaying as your Congressman, your Senator, and your President.
I think folks in small towns need to band together and stand up for our schools, our jobs, and our communities before they’re all gone.
**It’s time to put the power back into the hands of our neighbors, and for Democrats to expand the map. That’s why I’m excited to launch Small Town PAC.**
I’m ready to pass the baton and get out on the road to find some teachers, nurses, veterans, laborers, and young people in small towns across the country who can represent their communities better than Silicon Valley and corrupt Republicans.
We need a new generation of elected leaders in this country – and lord knows the Democrats need some new faces. So let’s go recruit some good people with bold energy and fresh ideas who actually understand small towns and are willing to fight for them.
We’re on a mission to build a party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
[**If you believe in putting small towns back at the forefront of American politics, rush a donation and become a founding donor to Small Towns PAC on Day 1.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260420.MsjlS-&amount=5&refcode=em20260420-502&t=2&akid=502%2E34582%2E6heohv)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260420.MsjlS-&amount=5&refcode=20260420-502&t=21&akid=502%2E34582%2E6heohv)**
Let’s start talking to each other again about the issues that actually impact us. Let’s start taking the fight to the venture capitalists and robber barons who are ripping our communities apart. And let’s go win some elections!
I’m grateful to kick off this new journey with you, Peter.
More soon,
Tim

name: John Rich
subject: Help J6 veterans find justice
body:
I recently came across a striking statistic... 72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.

| | | [View this email in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1nibkt8p642036bnavk6n9136gs9gblio0cjov8_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs4be9tsktr2bui7f4808sapthnavli3btmbdpc0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zke9vq3ledfkirklsdp1o1a39ehijs0apkd1hpuo_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zli2l1hnt9egc9c2qga217e1ghcoh7njkrr70puo_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
[Donate](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt7mid7k27kph19ocvr28qjc5970i1v6ts2aih78_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3nvg1prdn87iddo1bp5bhkb4r81li21op3lr5no_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
[Donate $10](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za3ivvjvokbsbkrtqmt4ahl46ak3sb7n9tvi8g6g_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $35](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zikjodc9p3d5brsl619699dg4nbsf7tfe41ifk6g_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $50](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs1ckm4qikt10e7nshhb4a6m61lkemtl2ps9i618_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjh4s2u5ftl80upm26f7fedvbgp9t8bne434ulk0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $250](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z232mas1r5j3de723nan3p6ekjjn6crik6f6edk8_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $500](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6bc43f7roa5cmtrfolp7g9g908v1k6ct4klk3ag_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate $1,000](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z84qoibd0fhhbldd5gn783ned04hat52jsmpoim0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)

[Donate Any Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd8cjq2p5alo51es6gpeambakif7ts533amdq7io_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
This isn’t about politics. It’s about justice.

These are real Americans — veterans, first responders, fathers, mothers, hard-working citizens — who exercised their First Amendment rights and were persecuted for their political beliefs.

_**If we don’t fight for our fellow patriots now, who will?**_

When you donate to Stand in the Gap, you’re not just defending individuals. _You are defending the soul of our country_.

**As long as there’s breath in my lungs and truth in my heart, I’ll be singing to honor veterans and first responders. I hope you’ll join me by taking action right now.**
[Donate](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoi2urelajejvu5m69k0qb3v533l6jqvcgj7ga3g_rp22sh2s8i6epr3ctg61o31cth2bs)
For faith, freedom, and country,

John Rich

Louisiana has one of the highest incarceration rates in the country. We know the history: Jim Crow juries, unequal justice, and a system that exploits incarcerated people for pennies an hour. My name is Jamie Davis, if MAGA didn’t like Calvin, they’re going to hate me. I’m the Democrat running for the United States Senate in Louisiana because I believe that people who know the brokenness of this system need a seat at the table.

name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Can you speak out for wildlife? Urge your Rep to VOTE NO on H.R. 1897!
body:
Check out Defenders' toolkit for more ways to urge your Representative to VOTE NO on the ESA Amendments Act of 2025!

Check out Defenders' toolkit for more ways to urge your Representative to VOTE NO on the ESA Amendments Act of 2025!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4874012/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4874012/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

As you've heard, one of the most devastating anti-wildlife bills ever written is coming to the floor of the House of Representatives for a vote this week. Now is the time to urge your representative to VOTE NO on H.R. 1897, the ESA Amendments Act of 2025, better called the Extinction Act.

It's not a coincidence that on Earth Day, a day to celebrate our planet's incredible wildlife and cherished landscapes, anti-wildlife Members of Congress are trying to push through a bill to eviscerate the very law established to protect animals at risk of extinction, the Endangered Species Act.

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4874013/38SyG9Xl)

I expect my Members of Congress to represent my environmental values on Capitol Hill and I believe you do too. H.R. 1897 does nothing to protect our most vulnerable wildlife. In fact, it will push many animals to the brink of extinction.

Together, we can work to defeat it!

As one of our most active supporters, I wanted to share a toolkit with you (https://support.defenders.org/s/4874017/38SyG9Xl) that includes additional ways to elevate your opposition to this dangerous bill. With a vote expected in the next few days, phone calls, emails and social media posts are all excellent and timely options to tell your Representative to VOTE NO on H.R. 1897. And all the information you need to take immediate action is in this toolkit (https://support.defenders.org/s/4874018/38SyG9Xl).

H.R. 1897 Advocacy toolkit (https://support.defenders.org/s/4874019/38SyG9Xl)

Thank you for doing everything you can for wildlife,

Caitlin Cattelino

Director of National Outreach

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

name: Rick | Bennett For Governor
subject: Why I’m running – and why it matters right now
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Bennett for Governor · P
body:
I’m running because I know we can do better – and because I’ve spent my life bringing people together to actually get things done.

| | |
---
---
---
Hi Peter -- I’m running for Governor because, like so many of you, I love Maine deeply. It’s where I grew up, raised my family, and dedicated my career. But today, too many Maine families are struggling just to get by. The cost of living is simply too high. Housing is out of reach. Heating oil, groceries, and healthcare costs are forcing impossible choices – choices no one should have to make in a state as strong and resourceful as ours. **I’m running because I know we can do better – and because I’ve spent my life bringing people together to actually get things done.** As Senate President, I earned the trust of my colleagues on both sides of the aisle. In business, I’ve turned around Maine companies and created jobs. And throughout my career, I’ve focused on practical solutions, not partisan talking points. As an independent, I answer only to you – the people of Maine. Not party bosses. Not special interests. Just you. And that matters, because the challenges we face won’t be solved by more division. They’ll be solved by leadership grounded in integrity, common sense, and a willingness to work together to get results. **But here’s the reality: campaigns like ours depend on grassroots support.** Our finance reporting deadline is midnight tomorrow, April 21, and this is one of our first major public benchmarks of the year. What we report will send a clear signal about the strength of this campaign. [If you’re able, will you chip in today to help us meet this moment? Please click here to donate.](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/donate?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=why_i_m_running&n=1) Every contribution helps us reach more voters, build momentum, and prove that an independent campaign can win in Maine. Thank you for being part of this! Rick Bennett

[P.S. With the deadline at midnight tomorrow, there isn’t much time. If you’ve been thinking about getting involved, now is the moment to step up and help us show what this campaign is building.](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/donate?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=why_i_m_running&n=2)

# **Trump Station? New York faces choice between modest Penn Station facelift or moving Madison Square Garden for iconic landmark**
New York City has a rare opportunity to create a Penn Station redevelopment that would rival Rockefeller Center, but Madison Square Garden owner James Dolan has his reservations about the concept, insisting "I'm not gonna move Madison Square Garden."
President Donald Trump **[told NY Post columnist Miranda Devine](https://substack.com/redirect/ad499ce8-4529-415d-9cd8-981e4b03f7f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he doesn't want to move MSG and prefers a more modest proposal keeping the Garden wrapped in an attractive facade while demolishing the Hulu Theater for a new Eighth Avenue entrance--though Trump said it wasn't his idea to name it "Trump Station," explaining that Dolan and developer Steven Roth proposed the new name.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad499ce8-4529-415d-9cd8-981e4b03f7f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The Grand Penn alternative** : One plan backed by the Grand Penn Alliance would move Madison Square Garden to a nearby vacant block, building a "soaring classical architectural masterpiece" echoing the 1964 demolished landmark with reconfigured platforms for optimal train flow. Financier Tom Klingenstein, who spent $4 million developing the vision, argues Trump's "name deserves to be on a big, beautiful building that's grander than Grand Central, not on the equivalent of an English basement train hall."
* **What 's next**: The federal Transportation Department must decide by next month, with the grand plan likely costing more than the $6-8 billion estimated for modest proposals. Proponents suggest Japan's promised $550 billion US infrastructure investment could fund "a grand new Trump icon in the heart of the city" rather than "another natural gas plant in Ohio."

# **GOP lawmaker calls Ilhan Omar "complete fraud" over $30M financial disclosure discrepancy, demands investigation**
Rep. Tom Emmer (R-Minn.) **[blasted"Squad" Rep. Ilhan Omar as a "complete fraud"](https://substack.com/redirect/c1068212-2335-47f8-801d-057d2fe6fc63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Saturday, saying "Not only should her accountant be fired, but that girl should be fired and she does not deserve to be in Congress" after a congressional financial disclosure listed her assets as high as $30 million. An amended filing reviewed by The Wall Street Journal shows Omar and her husband's assets were actually between $18,004 and $95,000--a dramatic decrease that prompted questions from Republicans and a congressional watchdog.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c1068212-2335-47f8-801d-057d2fe6fc63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Omar denies she 's a millionaire, blames accounting error**: Omar's spokesperson Jacklyn Rogers told the Journal "The amended disclosure confirms what we've said all along: The congresswoman is not a millionaire" and the filing was corrected "as soon as the discrepancy was identified." Emmer added that if Omar "is discovered to be involved in any of this fraud personally, that she benefited from it, even by her actions of promoting it and trying to resist investigations, she should be held accountable to the fullest extent."
* **House Oversight Chair pushes Ethics Committee investigation** : Rep. James Comer (R-Ky.) told "Fox & Friends Weekend" he's been "pushing the House Ethics Committee to investigate the matter," noting that because Omar "is a person of interest in the Somali fraud, I've been trying to get that."

Proponents suggest Japan's promised $550 billion US infrastructure investment could fund "a grand new Trump icon in the heart of the city" rather than "another natural gas plant in Ohio." | | POLL Should the new development be named after President Donald Trump? | ? ? ? GOP lawmaker calls Ilhan Omar "complete fraud" over $30M financial disclosure discrepancy, demands investigation Rep. Tom Emmer (R-Minn.) on Saturday, saying "Not only should her accountant be fired, but that girl should be fired and she does not deserve to be in Congress" after a congressional financial disclosure listed her assets as high as $30 million. An amended filing reviewed by The Wall Street Journal shows Omar and her husband's assets were actually between $18,004 and $95,000--a dramatic decrease that prompted questions from Republicans and a congressional watchdog. | | ---|---|--- Omar denies she 's a millionaire, blames accounting error: Omar's spokesperson Jacklyn Rogers told the Journal "The amended disclosure confirms what we've said all along: The congresswoman is not a millionaire" and the filing was corrected "as soon as the discrepancy was identified." Emmer added that if Omar "is discovered to be involved in any of this fraud personally, that she benefited from it, even by her actions of promoting it and trying to resist investigations, she should be held accountable to the fullest extent." House Oversight Chair pushes Ethics Committee investigation : Rep. James Comer (R-Ky.) told "Fox & Friends Weekend" he's been "pushing the House Ethics Committee to investigate the matter," noting that because Omar "is a person of interest in the Somali fraud, I've been trying to get that." Oklahoma students crown principal "prom king" after he was shot disarming armed intruder at their school Kirk Moore, the Pauls Valley High School principal, after students voted to recognize him for defending them during an April 7 attack where he charged at 20-year-old Victor Lee Hawkins--armed with two semi-automatic handguns--and was shot in the leg while wrestling him to the ground. What happened during the attack : According to investigators, Hawkins "entered the school, pointed his pistol, and yelled for everyone to get on the ground" around 2:30 p.m., pointed his gun at a female student and pulled the trigger but the weapon malfunctioned, then pointed at a male student before "Principal Moore came out of his office and charged at Hawkins." Moore and another staff member disarmed the deranged attacker who was reportedly obsessed with and inspired by the 1999 Columbine shooting that killed 13 people. Authorities praise Moore 's heroism: Police Chief Don May told NBC News "There's not a doubt in my mind that he saved kids' lives," while Moore said in a statement he was grateful for "an outpouring of love and support" and credited his "instincts and training, as well as God's hand" for being available to him during the incident. * You're currently a free subscriber to . | | Dear Friend,
You likely know that I was the chairman for the Measure to eliminate property tax that was on the ballot in 2024. I believe the measure failed due to a very well-funded campaign of misinformation.
Whether you agreed with and liked the Measure or not, I hope you realize two things:
1) **It is widely believed that without the push from the Measure, the property tax credit would have stayed at $500 rather than being increased to $1,600.** -and-2) **Win or lose, I have always fought for the citizens of North Dakota to pay less in taxes, and for those taxes to be spent wisely... I always will.**
I’m going door-to-door, meeting people, and discussing issues. One of the things I’m hearing most commonly is that even with the $1,600 property tax credit, people aren’t happy. **Increasing valuations are wiping out any savings that we should be seeing.**
People are telling me that it seems like the government is getting around the savings no matter what the legislature passes
There ARE things that can still be done! For example, about half of your property tax goes to fund K-12 education. The ND Constitution says that the state is supposed to pay for it, yet as far as property taxes go - it is the county and city paying for it. Friend, there's a new industry exploding across America. It looks like harmless betting – a few dollars here, a few dollars there. But underneath? It's something far more dangerous:
A fast-growing, barely regulated system where insiders, corporations, and politically connected individuals profit, all while ordinary Americans take all the risk.
At the top of this system, powerful players are making bets on things that should never be for sale. War. Foreign policy decisions. Even the timing and content of presidential announcements.
Platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi have enabled highly specific wagers on issues like these, placed just before the events ever unfold. And that raises a deeply troubling question:
**Who knew what – and when?**
When people with access to sensitive information can profit from it, it's not just unfair; it's a threat to our democracy. And when you add in the fact that Donald Trump Jr. is tied to these platforms as an investor and advisor, the pattern becomes even harder to ignore.
**That's why I need your help, friend. I've introduced legislation such as the Prediction Markets Security and Integrity Act and the Supporting Affordability and Fairness with Every Bet Act to make America safer and hold the administration accountable.**

subject: The Supreme Court's latest case about mail-in ballots

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042026_1&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
The Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. That means thousands of votes still counted, more than 1.5% of the total vote count. In a close election, that 1.5% could easily mean the difference between winning and losing.

### Europe's premier rightwing authoritarian was defeated last week. What can we learn from this resounding victory for democracy?
| | [Aaron Regunberg](https://substack.com/@aaronregunberg)
---
| Apr 20
---
| [](https://substack.com/@aaronregunberg)

Last week, the ranks of the world's rightwing dictators got a little thinner following the overwhelming defeat of Hungary's authoritarian leader Viktor Orban by his anti-corruption challenger Peter Magyar.
Like many pundits have claimed in the aftermath of this stunning democratic victory, my _[Fighting Fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/ed32b954-934d-40ba-b042-a33fef7013bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _co-hosts and I have always been experts on the politics of Hungary. (Just kidding. I'm often reminded in moments like this of an _Onion_ [article](https://substack.com/redirect/716c798a-b603-4c59-808f-d70daef0d00e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that came out shortly after September 11th, "Area Man Acts Like He's Been Interested in Afghanistan All Along.")
So we invited two actual experts who have spent a great deal of time studying Orban's regime--senior _Vox_ correspondent Zack Beauchamp and political scientist Dr. Jennifer McCoy--to join us on the podcast to talk through how Magyar beat Hungary's longtime strongman and what lessons this victory might offer for our fight against fascism here in the United States. If you were excited about Hungary's watershed election and want to understand the dynamics better, I definitely recommend checking out this episode--you can find it [here on Apple Podcasts](https://substack.com/redirect/609e84fa-6d02-408f-a453-2740897fca3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or [here on Spotify](https://substack.com/redirect/8f9eeabb-d76d-441c-ae10-9b06de1c7224?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There's one takeaway in particular I want to stress from this political earthquake. But first, I should share a caveat: International comparisons are tricky. As Zack Beauchamp warned us of Hungary, "It's a different country from the United States, with a fundamentally different political context and culture."
Still, I'd argue that there is a lesson for Democrats from Magyar's victory, and it's this: We need to redraw the lines of conflict that define our politics. As Dr. McCoy put it during our conversation, "When we're experiencing what we call 'pernicious polarization'--extreme toxic polarization that's harming democracy--then simply trying to depolarize may not work, because it's very hard to bring together these two sides that have been so polarized. Instead, we need to shift the axis of conflict that the incumbent government has polarized around--whether that's left-versus-right, or in the case of Hungary, EU-versus-Russia--to another definition of the conflict that can galvanize a large majority of people."
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9hYXJvbnJlZ3VuYmVyZy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjE5NDY1Njk0MiwicyI6NDk4MTE3MCwiZiI6dHJ1ZSwidSI6OTA1MDExOTIsImlhdCI6MTc3NjY5ODc2NCwiZXhwIjoyMDkyMjc0NzY0LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMCIsInN1YiI6ImxpbmstcmVkaXJlY3QifQ.jEqTU1eWxK4NaWrFFn46BtUcluAMgxN8R1xIROhmZeo?)
So what was the axis of conflict around which Magyar sought to repolarize the Hungarian people? As Dr. McCoy explained, "Magyar defined the conflict as the nation versus the clan, referring to Orban's clan, by which he meant a corrupt oligarchy. And by the nation he meant the good of the people."
It is indisputable that Magyar ran against the corruption of Orban's billionaire buddies. He [decried](https://substack.com/redirect/ce4f0daa-a02c-4009-9bb1-041c3e241574?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) how "a few families own half the country." He [proposed](https://substack.com/redirect/a6677d65-3f09-4dd9-9221-7071f7c89aa7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a wealth tax on the ultra rich. He [promised](https://substack.com/redirect/072164ea-92d3-4b6d-9c32-ffcc045b3cb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to end the culture of elite impunity that flourished under Orban. As Dr. McCoy summarized, "It used to be called the 99% versus the 1%. It's the people of the country versus the billionaires, versus the corrupt oligarchy."
Magyar's approach here should sound very familiar to anyone who's heard James Talarico [say](https://substack.com/redirect/9813fb98-443e-412a-905c-73a165917f5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "It's not left versus right, it's top versus bottom," or Graham Platner [growl](https://substack.com/redirect/69d2c24a-e292-4352-b934-c917e1ff40cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "The enemy is the oligarchy--it's the billionaires who pay for it and the politicians who sell us out," or Zohran Mamdani [announce](https://substack.com/redirect/dd2c2c97-8f43-4769-88a3-2f4f3cc5e3e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "We're taxing the rich," or Elizabeth Warren [declare](https://substack.com/redirect/87173575-0507-4c21-93c0-d8e3094f299a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "The wealthy have avoided accountability time and again," or heard Bernie Sanders speak for more than two minutes at any point in his life.
This is an axis of conflict that can appeal to any society defined by extreme inequality, where the system feels rigged and the wealthy and well-connected get away with murder. And it's an approach that Democrats absolutely must embrace if they want to build the kind of big-tent majorities necessary to do to Trumpism what Magyar just did to Orbanism.
Most rank-and-file Democrats seem to understand this. Indeed, the only real obstacle standing in the way of this populist turn is the corporatist wing of the party--the elected officials, consultants, think tanks, and pundits who continue fighting like hell to protect their Wall Street, Big Oil, AIPAC, crypto, and AI patrons. In my opinion, if there's one lesson we should draw from the defeat of Orban, it's that these corporate shills are threatening our ability to achieve a victory like the one we saw last week in Hungary. If we want to build the kind of repolarized supermajority that Magyar was able to bring together in opposition to Orban, we need to break the corporatists' stranglehold on the Democratic Party--and once it's broken, we must never look back.
Thanks for reading! If you liked this post, please feel free to share it.

Indeed, the only real obstacle standing in the way of this populist turn is the corporatist wing of the party--the elected officials, consultants, think tanks, and pundits who continue fighting like hell to protect their Wall Street, Big Oil, AIPAC, crypto, and AI patrons. In my opinion, if there's one lesson we should draw from the defeat of Orban, it's that these corporate shills are threatening our ability to achieve a victory like the one we saw last week in Hungary. If we want to build the kind of repolarized supermajority that Magyar was able to bring together in opposition to Orban, we need to break the corporatists' stranglehold on the Democratic Party--and once it's broken, we must never look back. * **And consider making it a[monthly recurring donation](https://default.salsalabs.org/T050f73b3-9c30-44cf-8f70-004848533e76/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)!**

My opponent announced a massive fundraising haul of over $1.75 MILLION DOLLARS this past quarter alone!
Look, I am NOT a career politician with deep-pocketed liberal mega-donors.
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot, a Nurse Practitioner, and a Mom who decided to run for office because I was sick of watching the same mistakes being made in Washington.
When we flipped this district RED in 2022, it was a massive upset.
The Democrats have not forgotten that.

As a professor at Emory’s nursing school, I’ve dedicated my career to training the next generation of nurses — the people who will care for us when we’re sick, deliver our babies, respond to emergencies, and literally save our lives.
So I was outraged when I saw the Trump Administration’s latest attack on healthcare workers:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260420-nurse-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260420-nurse-rs]
Trump’s Department of Education just reclassified nursing as not a professional degree, slashing federal loan access for advanced nursing degrees nationwide.
Let me say that again: They are telling nurses—NURSES—that their work isn’t “professional” enough to deserve the same support as dentists, veterinarians, chiropractors, optometrists, and theologians.
But it’s not just about a title. The actual consequences will be devastating:
→ Graduate nursing students will lose access to the federal loans they need to become nurse practitioners, nurse anesthetists, midwives, and clinical specialists.
→ Nationwide nursing shortages will grow worse.
→ And patients — the people who rely on nurses the most — will pay the price.
This is a direct attack on the health care workforce. And it’s one more reminder why we need scientists, educators, and health care professionals IN Congress — not politicians who don’t understand (or don’t care about) the consequences of their actions.
I’m running for Congress because I’ve seen what happens when politicians who know nothing about medicine make decisions that endanger patients and disrespect the healthcare workers who keep this country running. But I can’t fight this fight alone. So please, will you donate $10, $25, or whatever you can to help me win this race and bring a fresh and needed perspective to Congress? clean_body: [] [] As a professor at Emory’s nursing school, I’ve dedicated my career to training the next generation of nurses — the people who will care for us when we’re sick, deliver our babies, respond to emergencies, and literally save our lives. So I was outraged when I saw the Trump Administration’s latest attack on healthcare workers: [] Trump’s Department of Education just reclassified nursing as not a professional degree, slashing federal loan access for advanced nursing degrees nationwide. Let me say that again: They are telling nurses—NURSES—that their work isn’t “professional” enough to deserve the same support as dentists, veterinarians, chiropractors, optometrists, and theologians. But it’s not just about a title. The actual consequences will be devastating: → Graduate nursing students will lose access to the federal loans they need to become nurse practitioners, nurse anesthetists, midwives, and clinical specialists. → Nationwide nursing shortages will grow worse. → And patients — the people who rely on nurses the most — will pay the price. This is a direct attack on the health care workforce. And it’s one more reminder why we need scientists, educators, and health care professionals IN Congress — not politicians who don’t understand (or don’t care about) the consequences of their actions. I’m running for Congress because I’ve seen what happens when politicians who know nothing about medicine make decisions that endanger patients and disrespect the healthcare workers who keep this country running. But I can’t fight this fight alone. So please, will you donate $10, $25, or whatever you can to help me win this race and bring a fresh and needed perspective to Congress? subject: Now Taking Democracy Summer Applications!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
The work of Team Lizzie has always been about building a coalition to make positive change—in our congressional district and all across our country. We are connecting communities, training the next generation of leaders, and electing Democrats in Texas and beyond.
That’s why I am glad to announce that, once again this year, we will be participating in Democracy Summer.
STUDENTS CAN APPLY HERE [https://democracy-summer.breezy.hr/p/c6a41032fd90-rep-lizzie-fletcher-tx-07]
What is Democracy Summer? My friend and colleague Congressman Jamie Raskin founded Democracy Summer to train high school and college students in voter registration, political organizing, and the history of social and political change. The fellowship is a six-week program with hands-on lessons in our TX-07 campaign office as well as virtual meetings with leading historians, law professors, political organizers and union and elected leaders from all across the country each week. This program is an incredible opportunity to gain an intensive education in the historical struggle for democratic freedom and essential lessons for effective political leadership today.
The deadline to apply is Friday, May 8.
STUDENTS CAN APPLY HERE [https://democracy-summer.breezy.hr/p/c6a41032fd90-rep-lizzie-fletcher-tx-07]
Democracy Summer has grown from a local organizing effort into a nationwide force for the defense of democracy and freedom—already training more than 3,500 college and high school students in 48 states, Washington, D.C. and Puerto Rico in prior election cycles.
I hope you will encourage high school and college students you know who might be interested to apply. (And, members of Congress from all over the country participate in this program. So, if you know students who live somewhere else that might be interested, share this with them, too!)
Thank you again for all you do—for your support, commitment, and partnership.
Together, we can do anything,
Lizzie Signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

clean_body: We don’t have enough of these right now | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

> Well, it's official. Washington state, in its infinite progressivist wisdom, has decided to wade deep into the regressive taxation abyss and impose an unconstitutional personal income tax. The bill dubbed "The millionaire's tax," will be the death nail that finally aligns Washington state with other bankrupt states like California, Illinois, and of course New York; every one of them completely run by progressive Democrats.
> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.BhMz-NMwyORWIjDJPRttCXFLGJDjzXowxNw9kf0de9k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=194812515)
> As predicted, the exodus has already begun; as titans of industry like Jeff Bezos and Howard Schultz, and numerous others have already made their way to the exit ramps, heading east for tax-friendlier climates in states like Florida, Texas, Tennessee, and South Carolina; and why wouldn't they? This isn't just a matter of a few billionaires wanting to keep their hard-earned dollars; they are taking their companies, their innovations, and most importantly, their tax-paying jobs with them.
>
> The Washington Democrat leadership believes its misguided financial priorities could be solved by picking the pockets of the very people that drive the economy. The Jeff Bezos and Howard Schultz's of the world have decided to not cling to the sinking ship that is Washington state. It's also worth noting, they are simply the tip of the iceberg, as Boeing has not only moved its headquarters from the emerald city years ago, but is incrementally shifting its plane manufacturing, production, and full assembly to plants in South Carolina and Kansas. This is about to get real ugly, real fast; and don't forget to thank your local Democrats.
>
> South Carolina has been openly courting the plane maker and is in the process of building another 1.2 million square foot final assembly plant for the 787 Dreamliner, thus eliminating Washington workers from the process completely. This expansion is expected to increase 787 production from 7 to10 per month: with a potential target of 16 per month in the near future. It's expected to create at least 3500 new jobs including new construction jobs: all in states other than Washington.
>
> To give you some context of the Democrat fiscal ineptitude, the Boeing company's total workforce grew by 5.5% in year ending 2025; and despite the increase, Boeings workforce shrunk by 4% last year in Washington state. You don't need to be a mathematician to see the seismic shift away from Washington's unhospitable business climate. Washington Democrats continue to find new ways to shoot themselves and its citizenry in the financial foot.
>
> But these companies are not just leaving; they are taking thousands of high paying jobs with them. Jobs that support countless families, immeasurable small and local businesses, and jobs that drive our economic tax base. To be clear, this isn't about "taxing the wealthy," as the Democrats like to say, it's about a fundamental lack of understanding of simple economics by the Democrat establishment. The sheer audacity to brand this as a "millionaire's tax" is a manipulative attempt to garner support from the useful idiots, while demonizing success.
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/8b819af3-3ae0-4663-9e15-581cdde6163d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
> ---|---|---
> The economic downturn created by this tax will be felt for decades. Thousands of Washington employees and their families will either be laid off, terminated or forced to relocate, uprooting countless generations of Washington tax paying families. This isn't just a financial issue for these people; it will become a humanitarian issue that doesn't end at the state line. The degree of indifference by the Democrat establishment in this state is simply abhorrent.
>
> The argument that this tax is necessary to fund essential public services is a pure canard perpetrated by the same negligent bureaucrats that created this spending frenzy. The fiscal irresponsibility, the wasteful spending, and the inefficient allocation of Washington's precious resources are all symptomatic of thoughtless progressive policies. Every bit of this financial implosion was self-inflicted by Democrat lawmakers.
>
> So, as the exodus continues and the captains of industry head for the border, let's remember a few key factors. First, Washington has become a state that discourages wealth creation and punishes success. Second, the so-called "millionaires' tax" isn't just a tax on millionaires; it's the progressive trojan horse for wealth redistribution, which will most certainly pull Washington closer to the rocky shore of economic collapse. Third, and probably the most repugnant of all, this is what happens when ideology and ignorance are elected to office, and they choose to sacrifice communal prosperity for personal and political gain.
>
> Washington's Democrat lawmakers have effectively told our most productive citizens, just like the states of New York, California and Illinois have, to take their talents and their treasure to states that actually value their civic contributions. And guess what? That's exactly what they've done. At the time of writing this column, New York Governor Kathy Hochul was speaking at a Politico event, cup in hand, begging those that already fled New York for West Palm Beach to come back and contribute to New Yorks financial calamity. You simply can't make this stuff up.

body:
For countless Georgia women, the stakes in the May 19th couldn’t be higher.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012AHVrJkblKAdOmDEpwyM_3OI6kEpYdK-B8RaeY8EayLu5Wqr5JYJbHBQzq7wjxjYUQEIgXT_DAEVaLzMqCT5fDmjwM38P5j8uFP_wK6GQlfrcFbecdjpR9GPStXYidmpb8_YybCjkw9eftTncbhapMyVf_zZlXTqosL9bEGVyn1dbvq7au5HHDcFlv-GB9mwCBbYHOYb04t2-CY-HXBI3Z6A-0vuwGaYRKuyuI8AT-I=&c=nBcutYffTqCTCo0bBLLunK-koETeHpYxBVn25T1E4I6_rdimIbg6Bw==&ch=l4zR_DvHvBjz9OCs6J0R7wsERyupJX4iez4bSUdLpKNOHaWvYB3a-Q==)
---
|
"Promise me you'll take care of my son."
Those were the last words Amber Nicole Thurman said to her own mother before being taken into surgery.
She should have lived.
Doctors say a routine procedure could have saved her--but they waited, fearing prosecution under Georgia's abortion ban. That delay cost Amber her life and left her son without a mother.
This is not an isolated tragedy. It is the direct consequence of decisions made by the Georgia Supreme Court.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012AHVrJkblKAdOmDEpwyM_3OI6kEpYdK-B8RaeY8EayLu5Wqr5JYJbHBQzq7wjxjYUQEIgXT_DAEVaLzMqCT5fDmjwM38P5j8uFP_wK6GQlfrcFbecdjpR9GPStXYidmpb8_YybCjkw9eftTncbhapMyVf_zZlXTqosL9bEGVyn1dbvq7au5HHDcFlv-GB9mwCBbYHOYb04t2-CY-HXBI3Z6A-0vuwGaYRr_GhBLuuyM=&c=nBcutYffTqCTCo0bBLLunK-koETeHpYxBVn25T1E4I6_rdimIbg6Bw==&ch=l4zR_DvHvBjz9OCs6J0R7wsERyupJX4iez4bSUdLpKNOHaWvYB3a-Q==)
---

Make no mistake, the stakes in Georgia's Supreme Court election are life and death.
On May 19, Georgia voters will decide whether to keep justices who helped reinstate this devastating law--or begin to change the direction of the court.

name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: Its Out Of Control….
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
In business and in life, there is one rule everyone understands: Every dollar must be earned and every dollar must be justified.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| |
Dear Peter,
In business and in life, there is one rule everyone understands:
**Every dollar must be earned and every dollar must be justified.**
But in the Johnson County government, that standard has been lost.
Instead, we are seeing a pattern of unchecked spending and bloated bureaucracy, and taxpayers are footing the bill. Mike Kelly rubber stamps all spending. He issues a blank check to the staff.
**Costs are up about 25%. Government spending is up nearly 50%. That is not inflation. That is overspending.**
Here are just a few examples of what is happening:
* **County staffing has increased by 18% while population has grown only about 4%**
* **$20 million extra paid to Evergreen** just to cancel a contract
* **$3 million** spent on solar panels and a water system to flush toilets
* **$138,000** for a “framework” with no definition, no metrics, and no measurable results

This is your money. We have a **$1.9 billion budget** , the largest in our county’s history, and growing pressure on property taxpayers.
EVEN staff is ringing the alarm bells that the budget is not sustainable. And yet, they are receiving no leadership or guidance on how to address the problem.
I am running for Johnson County Commission Chair because I believe we need to get back to basics:
* Live within our means
* Cut waste and unnecessary spending
* Focus on core priorities that actually serve residents.

As a business owner, I have had to make budgets, cut budgets, lead through difficult times and make the hard decisions when something does not add up. You do not approve expenditures just because someone says “we need it.” You ask the hard questions. You demand accountability. And if the answers are not there, you do not sign the check.Johnson County deserves that same level of leadership.
But here is the reality:**If we are going to stop this kind of spending, we have to build a campaign strong enough to take on the status quo and win.**
That takes resources.
Right now, we are working to hit our **month-end fundraising goal** , and I am asking you personally to be part of it.
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://kcforjoco.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d540da3225ec5b2797f3018d2&id=b16781c49c&e=7320325a61)
---
| |
Whether it is $25, $50, $100, or more, every contribution makes a real impact. It helps us reach voters, share the truth about what is happening, and build the momentum we need to bring fiscal responsibility back to Johnson County.
This is not just about a campaign.
It is about stopping waste, restoring accountability, and making sure your hard-earned dollars are respected again.
I would be grateful for your support today
With determination,
**Karen Crnkovich**
Candidate for Johnson County Commission Chair

** The Autism Health Summit is This Weekend!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=bff65e8dea&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The countdown is on. With only 4 days to go, we are excited to welcome you to the Autism Health Summit, taking place April 24–26, 2026 in San Diego at the Legacy Center Resort and Spa. This powerful three-day event brings together leading experts, practitioners, researchers, and families for a weekend of education, collaboration, and meaningful conversation around autism and neurological health.

We want to share an important update with our community. While the San Diego Regional Center will not be sponsoring tickets for this event due to unforeseen circumstances, we remain deeply committed to accessibility. We are offering scholarships for low-income families who would like to attend. You must apply by April 17th to receive approval. As we approach the final weeks, we invite you to take advantage of our current offer. Use promo code Autism50 to receive $50 off your in-person ticket.

Earn CME Credits At the AHS Conference!
We are proud to offer Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits for medical professionals attending the Autism Health Summit. Participants who purchase a Professional Ticket will be eligible to receive 10.5 CME credits, providing valuable, evidence-informed education while fulfilling continuing education requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for physicians and healthcare providers to gain deeper insights into emerging research, clinical applications, and integrative approaches to autism and neurological health.

Meet Our Headline Speakers!
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=bff65e8dea&mc_eid=UNIQID

This year’s Summit features an outstanding lineup of headline speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Robert Malone, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, and many more respected voices in the community. Attendees will also hear from Ed Clay and his team at Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), who will share the latest updates and research surrounding their upcoming clinical trial for autism.
AHS AGENDA (https://ahsconference.com/agenda/?mc_cid=bff65e8dea&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The committee meets again TOMORROW—we need to be ready
Dear Peter,

The full committee met Thursday to debate SC S.1095—[**a total abortion ban that would criminalize patients, punish anyone who helps them, and strip away what little remains of rape and incest exceptions.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/129827161/615689455/2141984067?sourceid=1151276&utm_campaign=26emaab-0402aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=southcarolina&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTYzODM4ZS1kZTNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EF-Ii6StQYHtKygN1DJsHwG8igLCPbY33PcPAcYfd2U=&emci=462e3e65-9f3a-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=5963838e-de3c-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=954237)

They couldn't even get through a summary of the bill. There were too many questions. So they're meeting again TOMORROW.

#### [You don't discover that you're ](https://substack.com/redirect/1496114d-fa4f-4c5e-8e63-8f0664b37e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[NOT](https://substack.com/redirect/1496114d-fa4f-4c5e-8e63-8f0664b37e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ worth $30 million dollars one day and be like "its no biggie." Unless you're Ilhan Omar that is. ](https://substack.com/redirect/1496114d-fa4f-4c5e-8e63-8f0664b37e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I mean, does this sound plausible to you?
* A member of Congress files a financial disclosure showing household assets somewhere between **[$6 million and $30 million.](https://substack.com/redirect/66323d73-5b0e-4d26-9c7a-dda72036f7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* A short time later, after a few questions from the Office of Congressional Conduct, the same lawmaker amends the filing.
* The new numbers show assets between **[$18,004 and $95,000.](https://substack.com/redirect/66323d73-5b0e-4d26-9c7a-dda72036f7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

_**That 's not a rounding error. That's not a minor correction. That is a financial disappearing act worthy of a Las Vegas stage magician.**_
Rep. Ilhan Omar's team has a simple explanation: "accounting error." They insist she is "not a millionaire" and that the amended disclosure proves it. Her spokesperson told the press the filing was corrected "as soon as the discrepancy was identified." Her attorney added that members of Congress routinely rely on accountants and that nothing untoward or illegal occurred.
Forgive the rest of us for finding this explanation ..... **less than convincing.**

# **[Biden Files Leaked Online](https://substack.com/redirect/5aab77e7-6dbb-4572-8bac-fc0cca474fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
For years we all heard the rumors... Dementia... strokes... even _cancer_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5aab77e7-6dbb-4572-8bac-fc0cca474fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* But they were **nothing** compared to the five health files that **[have just been leaked online](https://substack.com/redirect/5aab77e7-6dbb-4572-8bac-fc0cca474fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
* See the **[stunning health information](https://substack.com/redirect/5aab77e7-6dbb-4572-8bac-fc0cca474fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the Biden Administration kept under wraps for four long years...
* And why America's top MAHA doctor is saying, **" I told you so!"**

[Get the unclassified files here](https://substack.com/redirect/5aab77e7-6dbb-4572-8bac-fc0cca474fdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Let's be clear about what happened. In one filing,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/66323d73-5b0e-4d26-9c7a-dda72036f7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Omar and her husband's businesses were valued in the millions.](https://substack.com/redirect/66323d73-5b0e-4d26-9c7a-dda72036f7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** In the very next filing, after scrutiny began, those same businesses were suddenly worth essentially nothing once liabilities were "properly" accounted for. The swing is enormous. The timing is convenient. And the explanation is the oldest one in politics: "Oops, our accountant messed up."
Omar earns $174,000 as the base congressional salary, her latest husband has investment ventures so the idea that their net combined worth may be a large number is not beyond the realm of possibility, but you have to be one hell of a dunce of an accountant to not be able to tell the difference between **["$18,004 and $95,000" and "$6 million and $30 million."](https://substack.com/redirect/66323d73-5b0e-4d26-9c7a-dda72036f7f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
House Republicans are not buying it. Rep. Tom Emmer called the situation a **["complete fraud"](https://substack.com/redirect/42f26ae3-98d5-4524-a803-b2b0bda62477?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and said bluntly that not only should Omar's accountant be fired, but **["that girl should be fired"](https://substack.com/redirect/42f26ae3-98d5-4524-a803-b2b0bda62477?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from Congress. He went further, stating that if Omar personally benefited from or promoted any fraud, she should be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law. Rep. James Comer, Chairman of the Oversight Committee, has already been pushing for answers and says the Ethics Committee now has "a lot of questions" for her.
This is not partisan nitpicking. When a public official's reported net worth drops by tens of millions of dollars in a single amended filing, the public has every right to demand a straight answer. "Accounting error" is not a straight answer. It is the political version of "the dog ate my homework."
What makes this especially troubling is the context. Omar has spent years positioning herself as a champion of the working class while living in one of the most expensive cities in America. She has railed against wealth and privilege, yet her own financial disclosures **[have now raised serious questions](https://substack.com/redirect/e3b0141d-e50a-4200-96b1-87d14a4dad4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about the accuracy of what she has been telling the public and the government about her own finances.
The rapid change in reported wealth is suspicious on its face. When someone goes from "possibly worth up to $30 million" to "definitely not a millionaire" in one revised filing, reasonable people are going to ask hard questions.

* * *
* * *
This needs to be investigated -- thoroughly and transparently. Not because Omar is a Democrat or a progressive, but because she is a sitting member of Congress who has a duty to file accurate financial disclosures. The American people have a right to know whether their representatives are being honest about their finances. "Accounting error" is not an acceptable final answer when the numbers swing this wildly. If any one of us did that, we would be be investigated. Omar should be to.
Ilhan Omar is, of course, entitled to the presumption of innocence. But she is not entitled to the presumption that the public should simply shrug and move on. The Ethics Committee and the Office of Congressional Conduct have a job to do here. They should do it without fear or favor.
**And** **if this really was an " accounting error,"** her accountant will (of course) be able to show how they managed to mistake "$18,004 and $95,000" for "$6 million and $30 million."
Right?
**Right?????**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2b21dfcd-6c1a-40d9-9862-de70c81a23b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Because if it looks like a duck, walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, it's not off base to say that it might, just might, be a duck. That is not conspiracy thinking. That is basic due diligence.
Especially when, over the last 15 months, there have been, some pretty revealing deep dives in to the...shall we call them "interesting" accounting practices going on in the burgeoning Somali daycare business in Omar's home state.
_**" We're not supposed to do that [investigate it] on the Oversight Committee, but because she's a person of interest in the [Somali fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/a987ba6f-54e2-4860-bcf2-a52e092ec636?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I've been trying to get that," Comer told "Fox & Friends Weekend."**_
After all, wilder things have happened Congress, **[just ask Eric Swalwell.](https://substack.com/redirect/fb8add99-a976-4881-bda5-470af00ff8ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The rest of us should watch closely. Because when the numbers don't add up -- especially by this much -- it is never just about one lawmaker. It is about whether the system that is supposed to hold our elected officials accountable is actually functioning.
Ilhan Omar's sudden financial vanishing act deserves more than a casual "oops, accounting error." It deserves real scrutiny. Anything less insults the intelligence of the American people.

| | At the end of March, President Trump issued an executive order directing his administration to create lists of U.S. citizens eligible to vote in each state and blocking the U.S. Postal Service from delivering mail-in ballots to individuals not on those lists. Since 2012, Washington state law has allowed every election to be conducted entirely by mail, with the state mailing a ballot to each active registered voter. **President Trump has no constitutional authority to change election law by executive order.** President Trump's executive order targeting voting is an unlawful effort to suppress the right to vote. No matter what the President says, there is no proof of widespread voter fraud in our elections. I have been an advocate for free and fair elections, expanding access to the ballot, and Washington state's vote-by-mail system. In 2023, I introduced legislation to protect U.S. citizens who face disenfranchisement because of restrictive voter identification laws. **Congress should be looking for ways to break down barriers so citizens can fully participate in democracy and have their voices heard at the ballot box.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to Rick Larsen instantly:

Patriot,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Peter,

After Trump tried to unconstitutionally deport more than 300,000 legal
Haitian migrants by stripping Temporary Protected Status, Ayanna didn’t
back down.

For weeks, Ayanna organized, rallied support across Congress, and secured
a majority of signatures on a discharge petition to force a vote. It
worked.

Last week, the House passed an extension of TPS for Haiti — a major step
forward in protecting these families and a true example of people power in
action.

Now, the Senate must do the same and help get it across the finish line.

Ayanna, alongside Alexandria, Ilhan, and Rashida, are standing shoulder to
shoulder with immigrant communities — defending them from the relentless,
targeted, and xenophobic attacks coming from Trump and his MAGA allies, no
matter the cost.

This win doesn’t happen by accident. It happens because supporters like
you step up, fuel organizing, and keep the pressure on Congress. That’s
exactly how our grassroots movement delivers results.

In other words: your support helps power the organizing that leads to wins
like this. If we’re going to keep up this momentum and continue fighting
for justice, we’re counting on this team.

---
Peter, I need to talk to you about something that hits very close to home for me.
16 million Americans are about to lose their health insurance because of Trump's so-called "Big Beautiful Bill."
Let me tell you what that number means to me.
My father worked his entire life on our farm. Broke his body doing it. And, like so many working people in Louisiana, we had times when we had to make impossible choices about healthcare. Do we take him to the doctor for that pain in his back, or do we save that money for the seed we need to plant next season? Do we fill that prescription, or do we pay the electric bill?
These aren't abstract policy questions when you're living them. They're the kind of decisions that keep you up at 3 AM trying to figure out how to keep everything together.
I've been there. My family has been there. And I know millions of Louisiana families are there right now.
---
So when I hear that 16 million Americans -- our neighbors, our friends, our family members -- are about to lose their health insurance, I don't see a number. I see faces. I see the grandmother who's going to have to choose between her heart medication and groceries.
I see the young family with a sick child and no way to pay for treatment. I see the farmer who's been putting off that doctor's appointment because he doesn't know if he can afford what they might find.
Let me be clear about something: Louisianans of all political stripes recognize this is wrong.
I've talked to Republicans in small towns across this state who are terrified of losing their coverage. I've talked to independents who voted for Trump and are now watching in horror as he threatens to take away the insurance that's keeping them alive. I've talked to Democrats who feel betrayed by a system that seems designed to protect the wealthy while abandoning everyone else.
Healthcare isn't a partisan issue when your child is sick. It's not about politics when you're sitting in a hospital room. It's about whether our government is going to be there for us when we need it most.
When I win this Senate seat, I'm going to fight for every single person who's terrified of losing their healthcare right now. Not because it's good politics -- though it is. But because it's the right thing to do.
Because my grandfather deserved better. My father deserved better. And the 16 million Americans about to lose their insurance deserve better.
