clean_body: Trump wants to disenfranchise these communities | = Peter, Donald Trump is so scared about what could happen in November’s midterm elections that he’s trying everything he can to keep Americans from the ballot box. He targeted mail-in voting with unconstitutional executive orders. He pressured House Republicans to pass a bill that would disenfranchise millions of women and LGBTQ+ Americans. And now, he’s backing a Supreme Court lawsuit that could bar states from counting ballots that arrive after Election Day — even if they were mailed on time. Thousands of Americans in rural communities rely on those ballots being counted. ******=**** | = The Supreme Court appears ready to side with Trump and invalidate ballots received after Election Day, regardless of when they were postmarked. That would have huge consequences in states with must-win U.S. House races like Arizona: more than 80% of Arizonans vote by mail, and they’ve safely done so for decades. A ruling in Trump’s favor could make it harder for voters in rural communities across more than a dozen critical states to have their ballots counted — and that’s exactly the point. # [100% HUMAN!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/04/20/100-human/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on April 20, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 04.19.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=75f264197dfe810e952e7e8dd1381a14384cbfe756df528b29555d203f9a4482&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7151&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=2f80af04ce1ccfb319c3e75f4b2958e9&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=ed0a976c38d3b95b467ae54c84b5f000)**
---
| **100% HUMAN**
---
I don’t claim to be perfect, but I do claim to be real.
---
When you read my newsletter or my social media, you are reading my authentic writing which includes my witticisms, foibles, and everything in between, (except for some Bluesky posts, edited by team members due to character limits.)
---
Recently, I rejected someone’s suggestion to use A.I. technology to create my newsletter.
---
But it got me thinking – does our U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, use A.I. to write his newsletters to constituents?
---
Well, according to GPTZero, he does!
---
I ran one of my pieces from last week’s newsletter.
---
GPTZero’s assessment?
---
**100% HUMAN**
---
Then I ran one of Joyce’s pieces from his last newsletter.
---
GPTZero’s assessment?
---
**100% A.I.**
---
I went with GPTZero’s assessment because when I tried Grammerly, it claimed some of mine was A.I. generated, which I knew to be false, so I couldn’t trust anything else they asserted.
---
But GPTZero was absolutely correct that mine was 100% human, so I could trust their assessment of Joyce’s writing. I was expecting some kind of mixed percentage breakdown between human-generated and A.I.-generated content, but holy smokes!, it came back that his was 100% A.I.-generated.
---
No wonder the guy pushes A.I. technology. He can’t even write to his constituents without it.
---
Don’t vote for that robot wannabe.
---
Vote for Beth Farnham to represent our beautiful 13th Congressional District because I’ll be REAL with you.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=ab941219b45f6be32e70196081e4a45a5f36bc167115bb39b5565df675aad524&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7151&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=3708f3c5538ddb4cfb4ddeab4e707a8a&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ed0a976c38d3b95b467ae54c84b5f000) and REAL Representation!
---
| |
---
| |
---|---
| | **Stopping the Abuse!**
---
While you may be feeling abused by the President of the United States of America as he whipsaws us from
---
destroying “a whole civilization”
---
to
---
suspending “the bombing and attack of Iran for two weeks”
---
to
---
blockading the Strait of Hormuz
---
to
---
threatening “Any Iranian who fires at us or at peaceful vessels, will be BLOWN TO HELL”
---
to
---
criticizing the Pope
---
to
---
whatever else a madman will rant about,
---
remember...
---
this could all stop tomorrow if our U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, and his Republican cronies in Congress wanted to stop it.
---
But they choose not to stop Trump
---
Capitalists thrive on war, division, inequality, and everything else that creates a downtrodden, abused, impoverished society too weak to defend itself against the rich and powerful. These are the same people who have voted down a higher federal minimum wage, a national healthcare plan, impeachment proceedings against Trump for his January 6th crimes, the Infrastructure Bill, the American Rescue Plan Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, and they voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that cuts healthcare and food assistance who need it the most.
---
They aren’t Christians, they just say they are. That’s why they won’t condemn Trump for his blasphemous AI image wherein he’s the Jesus who is reviving a dead Jeffrey Epstein. Jesus isn’t their Lord and Savior. Money is and Trump is the golden calf by which it is delivered.
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way. We don’t have to have a madman in power, hellbent on removing our Democracy or suggesting that people worship him.
---
The People have the power to vote against the John Joyces of Congress and vote for the Beth Farnhams instead.
---
I, along with other caring Democrats, pledge to increase the federal minimum wage to a liveable one, strengthen our social safety nets of food assistance and affordable housing, create a national healthcare plan, hold accountable Trump for his crimes against humanity and constitutional law, and enact policies that strengthen our people and national security.
---
Please vote for me because when you choose Beth Farnham, you not only [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=6d0eee815c4106981bbf8c3ee89a4a577e3637956ef51ad016633af7ff669c24&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7151&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b7853a927aff328d6a2586b60b43462e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ed0a976c38d3b95b467ae54c84b5f000) , you stop the abuse!

| Why the Trump Administration is Terrible for Public Education and Head Start
---
Many thanks to Gettysburg Area School District School board president, Alice Broadway, and Executive Director of Adams County Head Start, Jen Showers, for their informative presentation at [Adams County Democratic Committee](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=a8ec084891165c039653374b54eeba40c0ef6033324c15215461054e24e535ff&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7151&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=a7ba490ec9b799911e16cbc636e60504&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ed0a976c38d3b95b467ae54c84b5f000) headquarters last Thursday evening.
---
While neither presenter mentioned the President Trump nor our U.S. Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, and they kept their presentations completely neutral in tone and non-partisan, it was clear that funding cuts for public education that those two officeholders support are doing active harm in our community.
---
Titling her presentation, “How Schools are Affected by Loss of Funding or Delayed Funding from State or Federal Sources,” Ms. Broadway broke down the impacts into 4 easy-to-understand categories which I will give here as well as her information.
---
**Impacts on Planning and Stability**
---
– Inconsistent funding for curriculum
---
– Misaligning with Comprehensive Plan
---
– Delays in in strategic improvement efforts
---
(Forces “reactive decisions”)
---
**Impacts on Staffing Challenges**
---
– Hiring delays
---
– Increased reliance on grant-funded roles which would then be temporary
---
– Programming instability
---
**Impacts on Students**
---
– Academic interruptions
---
– Inconsistent student supports
---
– Disproportionate impacts on disadvantaged students including Title I funding and students/class
---
**Budget and Financial Strain**
---
– Quandaries about money sourcing
---
– Heavier reliance on reserve funding which is temporary
---
– Reduction in level of funding rippling across the budget
---
She then wrapped up her presentation reminding us that over 60% of the cost per public school student is born on the backs of the property owners (I’m paraphrasing here) indicating that if the federal government goes through with its plan to cut more funding, the needs of students will need to be met through some other means.
---
Having served on the Conewago Valley School Board in 2023, I know that that simply means property owners would have to pay more school taxes, not just for GASD, but for every public school district. Why anyone would vote for this is beyond me.
---
Instead, I believe that the ultra-wealthy should pay their fair share in taxes so the federal and state governments can fund the majority of a public school student’s education.
---
Ms. Showers then followed with her presentation on Head Start in Adams County.
---
Serving 130 children and families across 10 locations, mostly in school facilities, but 1 in a church, Adams County Head Start is 100% federally-funded by the Department of Health and Human services. Families that receive SNAP are automatically eligible as are families that are homeless. The majority of families are those of 4 members whose income is $33k or lower, or for 13 slightly higher income families, for those whose children have an IEP. In addition to providing education, Head Start also works to screen students for lead, nutrition issues, hemoglobin, hearing, and vision issues, as well as up-to-date vaccination records.
---
Unfortunately, federal funding cuts mean no Cost of Living Adjustments for 2027 and funding freezes translate to no money coming in, 1/2 of the regional offices closed, Harrisburg office taking on 8 states’ worth of programs, and 1100 centers reported 3000 open positions denying 25000 children services to help them succeed in school.
---
In short, funding cuts and delays to Public Education and Head Start paint a dismal picture of loss and difficulty. Of course, we can change this by voting in people who would actually enact policies that strengthen these social safety nets.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, so that our public school children don’t just learn, but thrive.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=d02aa0fee596dd31e1937a9e78d901f649174775e1eb73709590e8bd3b826867&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7151&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=98180cb397464b9a7585e444a9787a44&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=ed0a976c38d3b95b467ae54c84b5f000)!

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Hi Peter,
What if your next vacation could also help power climate action here in Oregon?
With OLCV’s Annual Celebration raffle, that’s exactly what your $100 ticket does. You’ll be entered to win a choose-your-own-adventure dream getaway, and whether or not you win, your ticket will help us do something powerful: recruit and mobilize volunteers to protect Oregon’s environment. In fact, one ticket can help us recruit up to three volunteers to take action for climate and conservation. [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Here’s what you could win:
🌴 Coastal Cabo Oceanfront Escape ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/8feUF78fa7s] )
A 4-night stay for two at a luxury beachfront resort in Cabo San Lucas: think infinity pools, ocean views, and total relaxation.
🏔️ Jackson Hole Winter Adventure ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/YkLQx7DhD6M] )
A 3-night alpine getaway with lift tickets, breathtaking mountain scenery, and your choice of a wildlife sleigh ride or distillery experience.
🌌 Grand Canyon Luxury Glamping ( click here to see more! [https://youtu.be/ldXeaK1CK2I] )
A 3-night stay in a panoramic Sky Dome near the Grand Canyon, complete with stargazing, live music, and unforgettable desert sunsets.
Buy your raffle ticket [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
No matter which trip you’d choose, every ticket purchased fuels OLCV’s work to fight climate change, protect Oregon’s natural places, and build a stronger environmental movement.
So yes, you might find yourself sipping a margarita in Cabo, skiing fresh powder in Jackson Hole, or stargazing at the Grand Canyon...
But even if you don’t, your $100 will still go a long way in helping us organize, advocate, and win for Oregon’s future.
Tickets are $100 and limited. Get yours now! [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Thank you for being part of this work. And good luck, you just might be packing your bags soon!

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

* Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars.

clean_body: A historic opportunity to honor veterans this Memorial Day| | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Patriot, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. Donald Trump promised the American people he'd lower costs and make life more affordable. He has broken every single one of those promises. Since Trump’s started a war with Iran, gas prices have increased sharply — hitting families every time they fill up the tank. Grocery bills keep climbing. Household energy costs have surged. If you're one of the millions of Americans doing the math at the end of the month and coming up short, I'm sorry. I'm sorry that the Trump White House cares so little about how their decisions affect working families. I'm sorry that while you're stretching every dollar, Trump continues to shovel even more wealth into the pockets of billionaires and wealthy corporations that bankrolled his presidency. We’re keeping up the fight to right the wrongs of our economy, and your story plays an important role in this work. **Because your story is proof.** When Trump goes on Fox News and claims the economy is booming, your experience can cut through the spin and make a difference. [**Have gas prices changed how you drive, where you shop, or what you can afford? Have rising costs forced you to make impossible choices? Has Trump's economy left your family worse off? Let us know here →**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpeconomy/?source=EW_EMZ30U_ECN_ENG_20260420_F&t=8&akid=2865%2E4032634%2Ew9qybB) | [**SHARE YOUR STORY**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpeconomy/?source=EW_EMZ30U_ECN_ENG_20260420_F&t=9&akid=2865%2E4032634%2Ew9qybB)

Let's be clear: this isn't happening by accident.
Trump handed trillion-dollar tax cuts to billionaires and Big Oil. He gutted the consumer protections families depend on. He's let corporations price-gouge without a single consequence. And while hardworking people struggle to keep the lights on, Trump is courting billionaires at his new gold-encrusted ballroom at the White House.
We see what's happening.
Behind every job report and every headline is a real person. Someone putting off a car repair they can't afford. Someone standing in the grocery aisle is doing the math. Someone working two jobs, doing everything right, and still falling behind at the end of the month.
**Trump’s economy is crushing working people. I’m raising the alarm about these blinking red vital signs — and I’m going to keep countering Trump’s lies about his economy with the facts.[One way you can help is to share your story with me. How have you been impacted by Trump’s economy? What concerns are keeping you up at night? I’m doing everything I can to hold Trump and his billionaire allies accountable, and build an economy that actually works for everyone, not just those at the top.

Elizabeth

Friend,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMHKpDAMgJ-m3pQ21XY89LAweJu97lFim9EMWout7usvDuwD_LeQfHx85M9rfCGvHOffuJHzF49HHhda08dcVOjAmN8cw-fMhT2NIMHUsq1B3hxUwflgNFTklLXGKuh0Xy1O-gl6M6Hq4N0pOXUeoVMBJgMPixoqdrdJtiBVrzptmkf7QFDB6r6dWrRetPJMAQvlxu8x03Fh4Ys4xv2e9tj4fatWt5SSstC_BAwChkz-PKjBSGEvN3HvCsZQc6zLQvWMScCQsEZ_S4QezrKNHreEPEehn_-zBJjvZY-FYhH66S-uDhfSX15XzsaKVs4b8vrtKD__3OXgXwAAAP__H8Z8Sg)
[Donate](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMHKpDAMgJ-m3pQ21XY89LAweJu97lFim9EMWout7usvDuwD_LeQfHx85M9rfCGvHOffuJHzF49HHhda08dcVOjAmN8cw-fMhT2NIMHUsq1B3hxUwflgNFTklLXGKuh0Xy1O-gl6M6Hq4N0pOXUeoVMBJgMPixoqdrdJtiBVrzptmkf7QFDB6r6dWrRetPJMAQvlxu8x03Fh4Ys4xv2e9tj4fatWt5SSstC_BAwChkz-PKjBSGEvN3HvCsZQc6zLQvWMScCQsEZ_S4QezrKNHreEPEehn_-zBJjvZY-FYhH66S-uDhfSX15XzsaKVs4b8vrtKD__3OXgXwAAAP__H8Z8Sg)
Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkMHKpDAMgJ-m3pQ21XY89LAweJu97lFim9EMWout7usvDuwD_LeQfHx85M9rfCGvHOffuJHzF49HHhda08dcVOjAmN8cw-fMhT2NIMHUsq1B3hxUwflgNFTklLXGKuh0Xy1O-gl6M6Hq4N0pOXUeoVMBJgMPixoqdrdJtiBVrzptmkf7QFDB6r6dWrRetPJMAQvlxu8x03Fh4Ys4xv2e9tj4fatWt5SSstC_BAwChkz-PKjBSGEvN3HvCsZQc6zLQvWMScCQsEZ_S4QezrKNHreEPEehn_-zBJjvZY-FYhH66S-uDhfSX15XzsaKVs4b8vrtKD__3OXgXwAAAP__H8Z8Sg)

| | Friend, **I’m honored to share that Moms Demand Action has named me a Gun Sense Candidate.** A grassroots powerhouse of parents and survivors of gun violence, Moms Demand Action is dedicated to a vital mission: passing stronger gun laws to keep our families safe. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129835895/615707424/-1274735844?&refcode=E29264-20260420-MomsDemandAction-Image-EndorsementOrg&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTQwOWFlNS1lZDNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s6SWeh73VkgP9h3KR6ciPq-zvoYzRAhTCy9tkERFi88=) This distinction is a recognition of the work we’ve done and are doing to protect our schools, workplaces, streets, and places of worship from gun violence. It's a reflection of our commitment to expand background checks, ban assault weapons, and remove illegal firearms from our communities. The reality of gun violence in our state is stark; nearly 800 Marylanders die from gun violence every year— _**and it is now the #1 cause of death for children nationwide. **_ While those numbers are heavy, I’m hopeful of the momentum we’re building. I believe that by focusing on common-sense solutions, we can make real, life-saving changes for all of us. That’s why I’ve co-sponsored key gun safety bills that deliver real-world impact, including:
* The **GHOST Act:** to curb ghost guns by tracking interstate shipment of gun kits.
* The **GOSAFE Act:** to regulate semi-automatic firearms and high-capacity magazines.
* **Ethan’s Law:** to establish a framework to regulate the storage of firearms in our homes.

No single law will stop gun violence, but with bipartisan support, these small wins will save lives. Team,

When I started kindergarten, the only English I knew was what I'd picked up watching Sesame Street. As a kid, I worked at my dad’s five-and-dime store, where I can still picture myself as a young girl, carefully lining up shampoo bottles on the shelves.

It's honestly a little surreal to think about how far I've come from that store. But I know exactly how I got here: hard work and a country that still had room for a family like ours to build something. That's the story I want every kid in America to be able to tell one day.

But let's be honest, that story feels almost impossible right now. Costs keep climbing. Families are stretched thin. And we have an administration in Washington that is only interested in taking care of the powerful, the wealthy, and themselves, rather than regular people actually doing the work.

That's why I'm running — to restore the promise that made my family's story possible in the first place, that in America, anyone, regardless of their upbringing, can achieve the American dream.

I can't do this alone. Will you chip in $15 today to help me bring that promise back? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw_em?refcode=260420_mgw_promise_l1&amount=15]

Marlene Galán-Woods is a former broadcast journalist and mother of five who has lived in Arizona for the past 36 years. Her parents fled communist Cuba looking for a better life. She met the love of her life, Grant Woods, and they raised a family together before he passed away in 2021. Marlene is running for Congress to stand up to extremists and be a voice for all Arizonans. body:
He was wrong to begin with, and has just gotten worse
| | | | |
---
| | |
# [Kash Must Go. He Cannot Remain FBI Director](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47338f34-58cd-43f0-8752-6bf333431d4c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td345dafb-1b9d-4877-a41f-2fca6dc75a76/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _([Go directly to petition](https://default.salsalabs.org/T856110e1-df2a-4a39-bedc-5ae6780d8266/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) | [More actions here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T26875fad-402e-44c8-af03-87ac8914eca2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [)](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcab6e210-085c-4eea-b771-8a05f9bd227e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_ Kash Patel was an abusrd choice for FBI Director, with zero qualifications for this critically important position. But a bombshell new [report](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8261881f-1ac7-40f7-af7b-d452a6e0eac0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) now adds some frightening new details -- bouts of excessive drinking, unexplained absences, and other utterly bizarre behavior that is making people across the political spectrum call for his ouster as soon as possible. **[Sign On: “Kash Patel Cannot Remain as FBI Director”](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1ffeeba2-f4fe-4174-81a7-68b1f570adbb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** And this was hardly the beginning: _“Patel’s behavior on the job — including his use of the FBI’s private jet and the bureau’s [security detail for personal reasons](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3d20aa9b-07ed-4bc6-9feb-d5ef091c6344/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) — have come under the scrutiny of lawmakers. A video of the FBI director in February [guzzling beer with the U.S. men’s Olympic hockey team ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T13e5a9c1-473f-49fe-b2a8-423215806223/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)after it won the gold medal in Italy, during a trip that his spokesperson had said was for security meetings, sparked [outrage in FBI and DOJ circles](https://default.salsalabs.org/T72f3958e-9a07-4c9c-875e-122ac62525c9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).” ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0d46590f-a70f-4f16-b6c9-5fa7a4e6d770/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ FBI director isn’t just any old job, it’s one that is essential to keeping us safe. And there’s no way Kash Patel should have it. **[Sign On: “Kash Patel Cannot Remain as FBI Director."](https://default.salsalabs.org/T91c4f071-5a00-4e99-8898-12622a41a210/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

A new WSJ report says military officials shut the president out of the command room. Add your name to demand safeguards now. |
---
Peter — The _Wall Street Journal_ revealed that military advisers intentionally excluded President Trump from the command room during a high‐stakes rescue operation because they feared his erratic behavior could jeopardize the mission and cost lives. Think about that:**the officials in the command room executing a critical military operation believed they had to sideline the commander-in-chief because he was acting so crazy.** _This man is not well. He’s unfit for the office of President of the United States. And something bad is going to happen on American soil if we don’t take action. _ I’ve spent my career holding powerful actors accountable — as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in the Southern District of New York and as lead counsel on the impeachment investigation into President Trump. Those experiences have taught me **we can’t wait for a disaster to take action. Defending our democracy means taking action before it collapses, not after. ** Our troops’ safety and security is at risk with Trump in office, but so is our own national security. We owe it to our servicemembers and to the country to act before something awful happens on U.S. soil. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

First, a new poll in PA-03 dropped last week showing Justice Democrat
Chris Rabb in a close second place, ahead of the Establishment’s pick and
just 5 points behind one of his corporate-backed opponents.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260420-cr.lQXEs2&refcode=em20260420-37687&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37687%2E1203867%2EW1xA5b ]Tweet from @harrisonlcann: 'Inbox: A poll commissioned by 314 Action
Fund - the STEM-focused PAC supporting Ala Stanford in the PA-3 primary -
shows Stanford leading the race, followed by Chris Rabb and Sharif Street.
The 'Not sure' option actually had a higher figure than any candidate';
shows Street at 16%, Stanford at 28%, Rabb at 23%, and Not sure at 33%

Then, Chris secured a huge endorsement from the Philadelphia Inquirer,
which said, “From the Iran war to healthcare, from climate to
affordability, and from housing to immigration, Rabb has consistently
offered the boldest and most ambitious leadership,” and he “has the fire,
passion, and conviction people are looking for in the current political
climate.”

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260420-cr.lQXEs2&refcode=em20260420-37687&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37687%2E1203867%2EW1xA5b ]Headline from The Philadelphia Inquirer: 'Chris Rabb in the Democratic
primary for Pa. 3rd Congressional District | Endorsement: At a moment when
the nation's fundamental values are under attack in Washington, the
pugnacious Rabb is the kind of leader voters in the 3rd District need'

He also picked up endorsements from the Congressional Progressive Caucus,
Reps. Ilhan Omar, Pramila Jayapal, Ro Khanna, Jamie Raskin, and Jared
Huffman, as well as Sen. Chris Van Hollen.

Now, we have less than 1 month left to reach voters before they make their
voices heard in this heated Democratic primary.

The Rabbmentum is real, but we need to keep it up to close the gap and get
Chris over the finish line before AIPAC starts spending.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260420-cr.lQXEs2&refcode=em20260420-37687&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37687%2E1203867%2EW1xA5b ]Rush a split contribution of $5 or more to his campaign

Thanks for anything you can pitch in to help us elect a progressive

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Donald Trump’s campaign just attacked Mallory.
[**This won’t be the last time they attack Mallory. Will you make a $10 donation today to help us fight back? →**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-april2026.vCnu4h&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20260420_PM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=2&akid=4514%2E898137%2E3MqynR)

Because the GOP sees what we see: **Mallory is the only candidate built to beat Mike Rogers.**
After outraising the field and turning in record-breaking signature counts led entirely by volunteers, it’s clear why the GOP is targeting us. They know _Mallory is our best chance at holding this seat and taking back the Senate majority for Democrats._
National Republicans are prepared to do whatever it takes to pick up this seat. _So they’re attacking our campaign and spending millions to prop up Mike Rogers._
We know Mallory has what it takes to win this race. But we need the resources to spread her message across Michigan and fight back against the GOP’s smear campaign.
And yes, we’re going to have fun while we do it.

I know you probably get quite a few survey requests. You might wonder if anyone actually reads them. When we sent a priorities survey to this team recently, I made it a priority to read your submissions. **Because I believe deeply in the power and responsibility of listening to the people I have the privilege of serving.** Here are a few things we learned, by the numbers: **🔋 Out of a list of 12 issues, 79% of you chose _clean energy and a just transition_ as a top priority.** From the concerningly low snowpack this year to the extreme drought our state is currently navigating, it’s not a question of how soon climate change will come knocking on our door. _It’s already here._ I look forward to setting plans into motion as governor to move our state to clean energy that is affordable and reliable. **🌎 73% of you chose _protections for our land, air, and water_ and _standing up to Trump _as top priorities, creating a two-way tie for the second-most prioritized issue.** Rest assured, I take these responsibilities seriously. As your attorney general, I’ve filed 64 lawsuits so far against the Trump administration to challenge their attacks on our rights, our kids’ futures, and our land, air, and water. And as your governor, I’ll use every tool available to protect the people of our state and fight for justice. **✍️ 45% of you used the open-ended option to discuss additional priorities.** I’m grateful you took the time to share your concerns. These responses added important details to issues like how we protect our land, air, and water, advance public safety, and provide mental health care. And thank you to those who took the opportunity to introduce other topics, like getting corporate money out of politics. That’s a topic I am championing as part of my belief in ensuring that ours remains a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. I appreciate every person who took the time to respond to our survey. | | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Peter... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Peter -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Peter, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

2026 candidates like Chris will need support. This means knocking on doors, going to events, donating, and gathering signatures. For independent candidates, it also means finding an experienced Campaign Treasurer. This role isn't difficult, but it takes a responsible person who can commit to filing the paperwork. body:
# [#] Hi there,

I wanted to share something that really inspired me this week.

I visited Sussex County Community College to see firsthand how they’re preparing students for good paying jobs. From hands-on workforce training in the HVAC and diesel tech, to cutting edge programs like AI and a new state-of-the-art Optics Center, SCCC is doing incredible work for our community.

This is the kind of investment in Jersey’s future that I’m committed to fight for in Congress, but I need your support to keep it up. Can you contribute $ or any amount you can today to help me support this kind of people-powered progress here in New Jersey? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2026-abt?amount=]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2026-abt?amount=]

I will always fight to support more resources for our state’s great higher education institutions. These community colleges are pathways to economic opportunity for thousands of students across New Jersey, and they deserve our investment.

While others are playing political games, I’m focused on what actually matters to working families – creating good-paying jobs, supporting our students, and building a stronger economy right here in New Jersey. Will you contribute today to help me keep working for New Jersey? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2026-abt?amount=]

Thank you,

Josh
Josh Gottheimer represents New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District. Josh is in Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values. He’s working across the aisle to find real solutions for New Jersey families and is actively fighting against the ideological gridlock in Washington. | | Aboard a combatant ship, chaos isn't just uncomfortable. It's deadly. That's why the Navy trains you to do the opposite of what your instincts scream during a crisis. Slow down. Assess. Act with precision and discipline. What Americans are living through right now is the exact opposite of that. **_Economic chaos._ **Grocery bills that keep climbing while wages stay flat. Market swings that wipe out retirement savings. Tariff whiplash shaking the businesses that employ our neighbors. _**Travel chaos.**_ Airports in disarray. Air Traffic Control understaffed and overwhelmed. Families stranded, flights grounded, and not a single straight answer from the people in charge. Political and legal chaos. Agencies gutted. Career public servants fired on a whim. The Constitution being treated as optional. **All of it has a cost, folks, and you're the one paying it.** I spent 20 years as a nuclear engineer on Navy combatant ships. I know what it looks like when a crew is well-led and what it looks like when leadership fails. I know the difference between a tough situation and a preventable disaster. **This is a preventable disaster.** My opponent Jen Kiggans has had every opportunity to be a check on this chaos, and she has chosen, again and again, to be a rubber stamp for it. That's not representation. That's abdication. The people of Coastal Virginia deserve a leader who thrives on order, demands accountability, and isn't afraid to tell the Commander-in-Chief when he's driving the ship onto the rocks. **This race is a choice between order and chaos.[Will you invest $15 to help me bring some much-needed Naval discipline back to Capitol Hill?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129838162/615715618/-507177815?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260420_FR_Chaos_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzA2ZjQ5ZS1mNTNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3TnmeK9uQbf2S1mu_dCb0hRcYFdSAC0vZdqK4RrHkiM=)** | | | [Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129838163/615715619/-507177815?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260420_FR_Chaos_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzA2ZjQ5ZS1mNTNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3TnmeK9uQbf2S1mu_dCb0hRcYFdSAC0vZdqK4RrHkiM=)

Friend,

_**Happy 4-20!**_ A day once viewed through a countercultural haze has become a yearly conversation about informed cannabis use and legalization. As part of our continued tour of Tennessee, _**we joined the conversation this weekend at the Hemp Festival in Jackson, Tennessee.**_ While there, I had the chance to talk to festival goers and share my common sense platform on legalization. **We all know that the current system is failing Tennesseans.** The criminal‐justice system still classifies cannabis as a dangerous drug and continues to disproportionately stigmatize and criminalize Black and Brown communities for possession and sale of a substance that is legal to buy in neighboring states. Beyond the harmful consequences of criminalization,_**there are real, tangible benefits to cannabis legalization.**_ We’ve heard so many stories, one from a young woman we met in Jackson, who told us that cannabis literally saved her life. She’s now in recovery, using cannabis to treat debilitating mental health symptoms. Stories like these are not just isolated anecdotes, they’re the reality for countless Tennesseans suffering from**epilepsy,** **PTSD** , **cancer** , and **autoimmune diseases** ,**chronic pain and illness** , unable to get the help they need because of the antiquated classification of a plant, by lawmakers who seemingly got their education on cannabis from watching the old _‘Reefer Madness’_ film. **The Numbers Speak** 🟢 63% of Tennesseans want to legalize marijuana. 🟢 Other states, like Massachusetts are generating nearly **$300 million a year** in cannabis tax revenue, funding education, health, and infrastructure. 🟢 Tennessee could become the next success story. Let's that revenue to repair our failing infrastructure: r**oads, fund schools, and support community services.** **What Our Opponents Fail to See**
**Marsha Blackburn recently reposted our platform, calling it “wacky.”** Like other politicians backed by the alcohol lobby, she is ignoring decades of medical research and the lived experiences of patients who rely on cannabis. She seems to forget the fact that **she receives millions of dollars from opioid manufacturers and Big Pharma** , a conflict of interest that undermines her stance on drug policy. **My Commitment as Your Governor**
**I am committed to championing legalization, both medicinal and recreational.** I will refuse to bow to Big Pharma or the alcohol lobby. Instead, I will implement a fair tax that channels funds straight into our communities, allowing us to repair roads, support schools, and enhance public safety. **Let’s Make It Happen Together**
The time is now and the next step is action, __**your action.**__ We need your help to keep the momentum going and to secure the resources that will bring Jerri’s vision to life. [**Can you support our push for legalization by making a donation today? Every dollar brings us closer to a Tennessee where medical and recreational cannabis are legal, where communities are healed, and where justice is restored.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129838178/615715665/1843264678?refcode=4..20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNlZjViZS1mNTNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R-zRRzb0z8hWvXriMVLiDlQoggu4Unb09A42UHFCyCY=) | | [GIVE TODAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129838179/615715666/-843357993?refcode=4..20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNlZjViZS1mNTNjLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R-zRRzb0z8hWvXriMVLiDlQoggu4Unb09A42UHFCyCY=)

clean_body: | Friend, Happy 4-20! A day once viewed through a countercultural haze has become a yearly conversation about informed cannabis use and legalization. As part of our continued tour of Tennessee, we joined the conversation this weekend at the Hemp Festival in Jackson, Tennessee. While there, I had the chance to talk to festival goers and share my common sense platform on legalization. We all know that the current system is failing Tennesseans. The criminal‐justice system still classifies cannabis as a dangerous drug and continues to disproportionately stigmatize and criminalize Black and Brown communities for possession and sale of a substance that is legal to buy in neighboring states. Beyond the harmful consequences of criminalization,there are real, tangible benefits to cannabis legalization. We’ve heard so many stories, one from a young woman we met in Jackson, who told us that cannabis literally saved her life. She’s now in recovery, using cannabis to treat debilitating mental health symptoms. Stories like these are not just isolated anecdotes, they’re the reality for countless Tennesseans suffering fromepilepsy, PTSD , cancer , and autoimmune diseases ,chronic pain and illness , unable to get the help they need because of the antiquated classification of a plant, by lawmakers who seemingly got their education on cannabis from watching the old ‘Reefer Madness’ film. The Numbers Speak 🟢 63% of Tennesseans want to legalize marijuana. 🟢 Other states, like Massachusetts are generating nearly $300 million a year in cannabis tax revenue, funding education, health, and infrastructure. 🟢 Tennessee could become the next success story. Let's that revenue to repair our failing infrastructure: roads, fund schools, and support community services. What Our Opponents Fail to See Marsha Blackburn recently reposted our platform, calling it “wacky.” Like other politicians backed by the alcohol lobby, she is ignoring decades of medical research and the lived experiences of patients who rely on cannabis. She seems to forget the fact that she receives millions of dollars from opioid manufacturers and Big Pharma , a conflict of interest that undermines her stance on drug policy. My Commitment as Your Governor I am committed to championing legalization, both medicinal and recreational. I will refuse to bow to Big Pharma or the alcohol lobby. Instead, I will implement a fair tax that channels funds straight into our communities, allowing us to repair roads, support schools, and enhance public safety. Let’s Make It Happen Together The time is now and the next step is action, your action. We need your help to keep the momentum going and to secure the resources that will bring Jerri’s vision to life. = | | = Thank you for your continued support. With gratitude and determination, Jerri Green Democratic Candidate For Tennessee Governor . Get your Jerri Green merch Green For Governor P.O. Peter, I flew combat missions over Afghanistan and I know what it means to trust that the people above you in that chain of command have their heads on straight. **Reports are now emerging that officials left President Trump out of the loop on details of the recent operation to rescue a downed pilot and weapons officer over concerns that his own erratic behavior would drive the whole mission off the rails.** Days later, Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz "fully open" while simultaneously maintaining a US blockade on vessels departing Iranian ports. Iranians responded to the lie by firing on two Indian commercial vessels and the United States retaliated by firing on an Iranian cargo ship. **Through all the Trump manufactured chaos, oil is now back up to $96 a barrel.** [**Help us put a combat veteran in Congress who has lived the weight of those decisions and will demand accountability for every single one of them.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8xm9O7ZyoqcCle4rmvcSSz2doH6jRghwK1PSIxCNzHevttj49-A8nYVCFWwMcpfoh0RmXm-20rHDY0TXEtQ5WdZNouuja7tuQ5C1HnyaIGrmtZvk-hUKFYtWWrBhw7Vm24a_F_MeW4PGaz_MlK2fE8qkuh4d764Yc26YAyxfay2pjADT9VWhNaNWoiwp8kPbZdTVcVMmewniIDoWm55K9pTNo0OJarH1OljWik-zl-GaVKJglRcMesOq98Jc9ilGbjB9l5oTIWieb2vfPFj7qASrcBTBbM0Mj2jkJOSNK1o1AP3A4W17aNiGEOgaAQBzug/4py/330nQh9YTLe2aDA3dfxfzA/h1/h001.HqXkDEr_XPp7CH6YGi1wP5hz4AoyUJ9PTGOwOjgaP30) While Trump's ego and delusions of grandeur continue to put our troops in danger, the man commanding our military has demonstrated a shocking lack of competence and professionalism while invoking dangerous language about this being a "holy war" that is now infiltrating senior officer ranks. Every operation I was part of had a chain of command that demanded competence, sobriety, and accountability at every level. What I am watching this administration do in real time is send Americans into harm's way without a plan and without the basic honesty to answer for the consequences when things fall apart. **You do not get to play wartime president when it flatters your image and disappear when innocent people pay the price.** Keith Self has watched all of this from his Foreign Affairs Committee seat and pushed back on nothing - choosing instead to fearmonger over Muslim Americans and demonize our immigrant neighbors. Our troops deserve better than a president and a Secretary of Defense who need a babysitter during a rescue mission. Our allies deserve better than a president who lies about opening a strait and starts a new firefight before the week is out. And this district deserves better than a nativist rubber stamp cheering the chaos on. clean_body: A combat aviator on what that means for every American in uniform. | | Peter, I flew combat missions over Afghanistan and I know what it means to trust that the people above you in that chain of command have their heads on straight. Reports are now emerging that officials left President Trump out of the loop on details of the recent operation to rescue a downed pilot and weapons officer over concerns that his own erratic behavior would drive the whole mission off the rails. Days later, Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz "fully open" while simultaneously maintaining a US blockade on vessels departing Iranian ports. Iranians responded to the lie by firing on two Indian commercial vessels and the United States retaliated by firing on an Iranian cargo ship. Through all the Trump manufactured chaos, oil is now back up to $96 a barrel. While Trump's ego and delusions of grandeur continue to put our troops in danger, the man commanding our military has demonstrated a shocking lack of competence and professionalism while invoking dangerous language about this being a "holy war" that is now infiltrating senior officer ranks. Every operation I was part of had a chain of command that demanded competence, sobriety, and accountability at every level. What I am watching this administration do in real time is send Americans into harm's way without a plan and without the basic honesty to answer for the consequences when things fall apart. You do not get to play wartime president when it flatters your image and disappear when innocent people pay the price. Keith Self has watched all of this from his Foreign Affairs Committee seat and pushed back on nothing - choosing instead to fearmonger over Muslim Americans and demonize our immigrant neighbors. Our troops deserve better than a president and a Secretary of Defense who need a babysitter during a rescue mission. Our allies deserve better than a president who lies about opening a strait and starts a new firefight before the week is out. And this district deserves better than a nativist rubber stamp cheering the chaos on. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| | Friends,

**I 'm excited to share that I am endorsing Amanda McKinney for Congress in Washington's 4th Congressional District!**

Please come and join me in supporting Amanda at her upcoming Bellevue campaign breakfast __this Thursday__ along with her fantastic host committee: _John Carlson, Hon. Joe Fain, Steve Gordon, Brian Heywood, Kari Magill, Bruce McCaw, Skip Rowley and Hon. Kevin Wallace._
**[(Click here to RSVP NOW)](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=9cec12e88b&e=77eef70c61)**
[](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=9188ab3fef&e=77eef70c61) Amanda and I have been friends for many years, and I'm confident she is the right person to represent Washington's 4th Congressional District. She is running to defend Central Washington, with priorities grounded in faith, family, agriculture, public safety, and freedom.

Like me, she believes the role of government is to protect citizens, not control them, and that decisions should be made by the people closest to the consequences, not by distant bureaucrats in Washington, D.C.

As a Yakima County Commissioner and former banker, Amanda has proven she is willing to stand up to government overreach, challenge failed policies, and deliver results.

I hope you'll join me this Thursday in supporting Amanda!
_**DETAILS:**_
**Thursday, April 23, 2026**
Doors open at 7:30am
Program starts at 8:00am and ends at 9:00am
$100/person or $1,000/Table of 10
**[You can RSVP online here.](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=076883a233&e=77eef70c61)**
_This event is hosted by Amanda_ McKinney _for Washington._
I look forward to seeing you there!
Reagan Dunn

I've spent a good part of the last week reflecting on my own faith as a Catholic after Donald Trump's repeated attacks on the Pope, the whole bizarre AI-generated image of himself as Jesus, and then seeing Sean Hannity say he no longer considers himself Catholic because the Pope is critical of Trump's Iran war.
And the point that's been rattling around in my head is this: if you're leaving the Catholic Church to choose your daddy because you don't like what the Pope is saying, then you probably weren't much of a Catholic to begin with.
* * *
_**Today 's rant is sponsored by Incogni.**_
_Unknown number calling? It 's not random._
_The BBC caught scam call center workers on hidden cameras as**[they laughed at the people they were tricking](https://substack.com/redirect/6ffa681d-6f0c-453a-8424-e196865392c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**_
_The BBC caught scam call center workers on hidden cameras as they laughed at the people they were tricking. One worker bragged about making $250k from victims. The disturbing truth? Scammers don 't pick phone numbers at random. They buy your data from brokers._
_Once your data is out there, it 's not just calls. It's phishing, impersonation, and identity theft. That's why**[I recommend Incogni:](https://substack.com/redirect/eb60cc57-078d-4677-ab04-14e8762a9838?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **they delete your info from the web, monitor and follow up automatically, and continue to erase data as new risks appear._

[Check out Incogni](https://substack.com/redirect/dca63d22-b849-4e41-a8e6-f0bbf26b41ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Because here's the thing: I'm not a perfect Catholic. Not even close. I have real disagreements with the Church. There have been long stretches where I didn't go at all because I was frustrated with it on a whole range of issues--abortion, gay marriage, and more. I think the Church is wrong on those things.
But the one that's most personal to me is fertility treatments like IVF, which the Catholic Church has said is "morally unacceptable."
My wife and I struggled to have children. We've had many miscarriages, and I wouldn't wish that pain on my worst enemy. We only have our son because of in vitro fertilization--because of a scientific breakthrough that helps people build families when they otherwise couldn't. I see that as a gift. A real, tangible, divine gift that solves a very human problem.
And the Catholic Church opposes it.
I've read the arguments. I've thought about them. I've prayed on them. I've talked to people who are far deeper into Catholic doctrine than I am. And I still think that position is completely and totally ridiculous. I say that with respect--but I mean it.
I was so angry about it when my son was born that I named him something that means _" gift from God,"_ because I wanted it to be unmistakable: no matter what any church says, that's what he is.
And if you've ever met my son, he lights up every fucking room he's in. Always a smile on his face. Feels everything deeply (just like his father.) He knows every person on the block. Everyone knows him. He's basically the mayor of our neighborhood.
And it infuriates me that my own church thinks we were wrong to have him.
That tension--between what I believe and what my Church teaches--is real. It can create distance. It can make me cynical. It can make me not want to go to church. I understand that feeling deeply.
But here's the difference: I don't walk away from my faith because of it. I wrestle with it, and I figure it out. How do I use it? What is this teaching me?
So when people in the MAGA movement get offended because the Pope challenges them--on the treatment of immigrants, on war, on basic human dignity--I understand the discomfort. They're being forced, maybe for the first time, to confront the idea that their politics and their faith are not perfectly aligned.
But instead of doing the hard work of reconciling that, they lash out.
They attack the Pope. They abandon the Church. They twist religion into something that conveniently reinforces whatever they already believed.
That's not faith.
Faith is supposed to challenge you. It's supposed to make you uncomfortable. It's supposed to force you to reflect on whether you're actually living up to what you claim to believe.
What we're seeing from a lot of these people isn't struggle--it's entitlement. They want a version of Christianity that never contradicts them, never questions them, never asks anything of them except loyalty to their politics.
And when they don't get that, they throw a tantrum.
An adult doesn't do that. An adult sits with the tension. They work through it. They figure out what they believe and why. They don't abandon their entire faith because one leader says something they don't like.
But for a lot of people in this MAGA movement, faith isn't about humility or compassion or self-reflection. It's about control--controlling women's bodies, controlling who people can love, attacking trans kids, and then hiding behind religion so they don't have to defend those positions on their own merits.
It's a shield. Not a belief system.
And that's why this moment matters. Because when the Pope says something as basic as "Blessed are the peacemakers," and your reaction is anger, that says everything.
It exposes the gap between the faith you claim and the worldview you actually live by.
I will always struggle with my faith. I will always have disagreements with the Catholic Church. Sometimes I'll be angry about it. But I will always believe in trying to be a better person because of it. I still believe I have the responsibility--and the agency--to think for myself about what that means in the real world.
That's what being an adult looks like.
What Donald Trump and his allies are doing isn't that. It's insecurity dressed up as conviction. It's people trying to bend faith to serve power instead of letting it challenge them.
They don't own faith. They don't control it. And the louder they scream about it, the more obvious that becomes.

Stop the chaos. Hold the line.
Derek, this is what elected leaders must do in the face of an administration that is intent on destroying our democracy for their own gain.
I have spent my career working for North Carolinians. Advocating for more resources for students in public schools and better pay for teachers. Building a clean energy economy to bring good-paying jobs to our communities while protecting this planet. Defending the right to cast a ballot and participate in our democracy. Fighting for Medicaid Expansion and winning it for the people. **I stand ready to do all this and more to deliver for the American people as the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina.**
_Far-right Republicans don’t tend to like that about me — and they don’t want me bringing this fight to Washington._
They’re attacking me in the media — President Trump has even done so from the stage at his rallies. They’re preparing to spend untold sums trying to take me down.
But I know how to win here. **And I will not back down.**
_Because I have you on my side._
**[Derek, this is the most consequential Senate race of the midterms. It’s the seat that can take back the majority, break the GOP’s hold on Washington and return power to the people. It won’t be easy, but we can succeed together. Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a56041bbe4d84e2dbdbdd7639f8c805f&_e=6KQUnZG5Ee3UcjXHPMy4O6G6SuGSdde5slgfiRCqRSh5hMm5mrEmC93ENGb6-aPNVsh9dMy4UaGvaGqO89sKnh3YfbmFePgnVXaokaiErC9HCnxuQRi81D18OFSewmj5OY-3qKN9EnvI_5Gjthaeg3Db6-tt2LRwaDwNysavP2Oqu7I3ryfuStECFrukH7cSO2jNs8Sjd8rrEHC_uLaNnnoFHkxRMIIcurWErWuXChPpVJm_-2IwVr3w7QXFapMQKY0o4DFqH6T1N3JgqX0k_G5Drs19FH1sFq5OSc4x05wq8ZPJGh6IDNQ_haSS0NWem0RasYC25hOTo770gYGGbSbldbgV7n3u1T2hwmizACLH1Gr_TlZPniX5o2yJ_dFxprftW_hJL_RD03zaYquMF5euUs2bd-kSGSvFxGJhVMq8B8EHLnJjPWBeLCPUPNyz1-1H42KpCCsL-bQZaWj5vgwBveU0MlqPYoXzB4txTrjZ0RpQiru13JHq53b0_O1UOq8UpbqzdFqN2gTbYqvsUzxNdhzy5iWh-mX4HOWtDKTyi_29DzxdKvumHg-O94SEKewddeGKMYvEzIN-PJYJYv6NLurotHs1ZS0eIQv06XkNW7pxnYo_jyg4jB3B-HfRykA5GcX5bCutKA14z1zPblck3L5OFXo3q0o8B18kbsSltgrDAfFtOGnvYrKnqY9V)**

| | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like:
---
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever.

* Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars.

* Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.
